postal_system.assignment_rule: The Universal Postal Union September 2025 Universal DataBase lists Dominica among countries and territories which do not require postal codes. The UPU Dominica addressing sheet shows a Roseau address without a postcode, and current Dominica government and UPU operator references publish postal offices and the Dominica Postal Service without a postcode assignment or code table. A form ZIP field, Dominican Republic five-digit code, AGID planning code, locality identifier or synthetic code seed is not a Dominica postal-code assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: No national postal-code assignments exist to anchor postal-code Polygon or MultiPolygon records. Island, parish, district, administrative, locality, neighbourhood, address, post-office, route, service-area, Point, buffer, hull, Voronoi, raster, AGID planning-cell and synthetic geometry must remain independently typed and must not be relabelled as official, derived or virtual postal-code area geometry.
postal_system.address_format_rule: Store recipient, organization, house or building number, street, locality and Dominica as separate fields. Do not insert a fabricated postal code into domestic addresses. International commerce or travel forms that request a ZIP or postal code are application constraints, not Dominica Postal Service authority.
postal_system.postal_object_rule: Store post offices, parcel services, postal boxes, routes, organizations and other service objects independently. A non-area object never becomes a postal-code Polygon/MultiPolygon without an authoritative code assignment and reviewed geometry relationship.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires a separately rights-cleared civic address identity and explicit reviewed relation to permitted point or footprint geometry. A locality, office, route, parish, parcel, coordinate, proximity or synthetic DM code is not an address-building relation.
postal_system.derived_and_realtime_rule: Models and realtime services may validate an address or service location only under source-specific rights. They must return no-postcode or independently typed context for DM, never manufacture a code or postal surface, and preserve source, version, request digest, time, confidence and derived status.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. DM planning cells and crosswalks may index separately authorized administrative, locality, route or building evidence, but they are never Dominica Postal Service codes or postal geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: The reviewed Dominica government copyright notice limits copying to unaltered personal non-commercial use and prohibits transmission or distribution without prior written permission. UPU material is copyright- and database-controlled reference evidence. No processing, storage, derivation, redistribution or public-serving right for a postal dataset is inferred from web access.
postal_system.jurisdiction_rule: Preserve ISO DM identity for the Commonwealth of Dominica. Do not merge Dominica with the Dominican Republic (DO), and do not borrow the Dominican Republic's five-digit assignments, examples or geometry.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Addresses, recipients, postal-box holders, parcel observations, coordinates, buildings and query logs can expose personal or property context. Exclude them from public artifacts unless authority, purpose, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: The no-postcode status is time-dependent. Store retrieval time, publication or edition, exact bytes and SHA-256, and re-check after the pending-country sweep or when the Dominica Postal Service or UPU announces a Dominica postal-code system. Never rewrite historical evidence as timeless.

stages.definition: Dominica address-format inventory, draft country pack, synthetic planning cells and conformance fixtures only.
Digest-bound Dominica government and UPU evidence that Dominica currently does not require postal codes, plus rights, identity, privacy, address-format correction and no-proxy contracts.

M2 requires a current authoritative Dominica Postal Service or competent public release establishing a Dominica postal-code system and a complete finite denominator of every code assignment, alias, validity interval, correction, exception and explicit non-area object, fixed with retrieval time, edition, stable identity, schema, coverage, bytes and SHA-256 under rights compatible with AGID processing, storage, derivation, redistribution and public serving. The UPU September 2025 list records Dominica among countries and territories which do not require postal codes; the UPU Dominica sheet and current government/operator references publish postal addresses, offices and services but no code assignment or code table. Absence is represented as none and does not satisfy the Polygon/MultiPolygon visualization milestone. If a future system is introduced, every drawable code must reconcile to a fixed real finite closed valid Polygon/MultiPolygon whose postal authority, official/derived/virtual class, source, edition, reference date, CRS, topology, method, confidence and exceptions are explicit. Dominica remains ISO DM and must not inherit Dominican Republic (DO) five-digit assignments or geometry. Islands, parishes, districts, administrative areas, localities, neighbourhoods, addresses, offices, routes, service areas, parcels, buildings, Points, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells, AGID cells, commerce ZIP placeholders, synthetic DM planning codes and code seeds are prohibited proxies. Postal-office, postal-box, parcel, route, organization, Point and other non-area objects must expose their type and reason without a fabricated surface and remain M2-unmet while no eligible postal Polygon/MultiPolygon exists. An approved immutable artifact must drive the real DM API/app, which handles no-code/no-match, loading, multiple, API-failure and invalid-geometry states, fits and renders translucent fill with a clear outline only for eligible real geometry, supports clear/re-search, and displays the selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence.

agid_integration.current_scope: DM metadata, no-postcode policy, address-format correction and synthetic planning fixtures only; no real DM Postal Context descriptor is enabled.
agid_integration.enablement_gate: A future authoritative postcode release, compatible rights, immutable assignment and geometry artifacts, and actual DM loader/API/app verification are required before enablement.
agid_integration.geometry_rule: Do not manufacture a Dominica postal polygon. Independently licensed administrative, locality, route, parcel or building geometry stays typed and source-qualified and never inherits postal authority.
